en: Sepia-toned postcard photograph showing a large neoclassical building with a tall portico of six Ionic or Corinthian columns and a triangular pediment. The façade is three to four stories high, with regularly spaced rectangular windows and modest ornamentation. In front is a cobblestone street or square, wrought-iron fence, stone posts, and old-fashioned street lamps. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand or walk near the steps. A utility pole with multiple cross-arms and wires appears on the left. A metric ruler is placed along the left edge of the image for scale.
